info.name: Robot rollout verifier Archive Batch API

items.docs:
Submit a batch of videos for ASYNCHRONOUS verification (finetune/h1
only — Opus is a per-clip call via /v1/verify).

`mode="single"`: one attempt per video. `mode="multi"`: each video may
hold several sequential attempts of the same task, auto-segmented into
per-attempt rollouts. Large files can be sent via the chunked-upload flow
(/api/upload/begin + /chunk) and passed as `tokens` (a JSON array of
upload ids) instead of `files`.

Returns a `batch_id`; poll GET /v1/batch/{id} until status is `do

Poll a batch. Returns `status` (`running`/`done`/`error`), progress
(`done`/`total`), and `results` — the finished items so far in the clean
per-video shape. Results are small (no frames), so the full list is
returned every poll; a result appears once its video finishes verifying.
